attrs.evidence: trvm_world.mjs L-FRAME-1: 120/120 random writes (23 inside the evidence, 97 outside) with the predicted verdict matching the actual freshness classification on every draw.
attrs.statement: The frame rule at the world layer (sigma T4's instance): a write's effect on a warrant's verdict is exactly predicted by footprint membership and scope influence. Writes outside a warrant's evidence (neither an exact-read resource nor influencing any scope result) can NEVER change its verdict; writes inside change it as classified (support hit -> support_changed; scope influence -> scope_dirty; non-support exact hit -> support_intact).
